states.name: Flamby
states.title: Flamby
states.description: A hot-tempered bird commonly found in the plains. Although they usually prey upon insects and small rodents, they have been known to attack passersby when startled.

states.name: Chardinal
states.title: Chardinal
states.description: Evolved Flambies have more powerful flames than their infant forms, and are seen as a pest by farmers due to their nasty habit of igniting crops whilst hunting for food.
